Name: CHAOS_MATCHING_REPLACE_TREASURE_COMMON_PARAM_ST
Description: Deep of Night treasure replacement settings (row 0): the range of replacement groups a session draws from.

Fields.Name: Replacement Group Min
Fields.Description: Lowest replacement group a session can draw. Each Deep of Night session draws one group between this and the maximum (both included); ChaosMatchingReplaceTreasureTable rows of that group apply. Minimum above maximum: no treasure is replaced. Retail: 1.

Fields.Name: Replacement Group Max
Fields.Description: Highest replacement group a session can draw (included). Retail: 5.
